tagline: Providing transparent and competitive payment options to consumers
hero_kpi_rationale: Four's GMV is a key indicator of the company's growth, with a 144.2% increase in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting growing consumer adoption of BNPL solutions

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue increased 0.4% to $2.4 billion in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by significant growth in Four segment offset by Progressive Leasing decline due to Big Lots bankruptcy and tightened decisioning
kpis.signal: Modest revenue growth driven by Four segment expansion offset by Progressive Leasing decline

kpis.name: Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) of Four
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions processed through the Four BNPL platform
kpis.description: Four GMV increased $435.0 million or 144.2% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily driven by continued consumer adoption and utilization of BNPL transactions at higher rates
kpis.signal: Strong growth in Four GMV reflecting increased consumer adoption of BNPL offerings

kpis.name: Provision for Lease Merchandise Write-Offs
kpis.explanation: Expected losses provision as percentage of lease portfolio, reflecting credit risk management
kpis.description: Provision for lease merchandise write-offs was 7.5% in 2025, maintained within the company's annual targeted range through tightened decisioning in early 2025 despite elevated delinquencies and cost of living pressures
kpis.signal: Provision maintained within annual target range despite macroeconomic headwinds

kpis.name: Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) of Four in 2025
kpis.explanation: Total value of transactions processed through the Four BNPL platform in 2025
kpis.description: Four GMV increased $435.0 million or 144.2% in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily driven by continued consumer adoption and utilization of BNPL transactions at higher rates across the United States
kpis.signal: Exceptional growth in Four GMV demonstrates strong market demand for BNPL solutions

ai_positioning.summary: No information available regarding PROG Holdings' positioning on artificial intelligence
